status_effects.explanation: The narrator's specific vindication of Saint-Loup is quietly reversed by a later, ironic aside confirming the rumor was true, mildly diminishing his standing despite the narrator's earlier defense.

appraisal_events.evidence: Je pus les démentir de la façon la plus formelle en ce qui concernait Saint-Loup. Mais ce qui est curieux, c'est que plus tard, si l'on apprit que ces bruits étaient vrais pour tous les quatre...
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator singles out Saint-Loup to formally deny rumors of intimacy within the foursome, but the passage then ironically undercuts this confident denial by noting the rumors were later confirmed true for all four.
